 Social Security payment changes ahead in 2027
 USA TODAY Tue, November 17, 2026 at 7:53 AM EST Social Security payments go out Wednesday, November 18, for beneficiaries born between the 11th and 20th. 
 Video Transcript 00:00 Speaker A Social Security payments go out Wednesday, November 18th for beneficiaries born between the 11th and 20th. 
 00:07 Speaker A Payments generally arrive on Wednesdays with the schedule based on each recipient's birth date. 
 00:13 Speaker A Those born between the 21st and 31st receive November payments on the fourth Wednesday. 
 00:19 Speaker A A 3.6% cost of living adjustment follows in 2027, up from 2.8% in 2026. 
 00:26 Speaker A The increase takes effect with social security benefits paid in January 2027. 
 00:31 Speaker A Increased supplemental security income payments begin December 31st, 2026.
